hero.headline: About Wireless Connect
hero.subheadline: Locally owned and operated in Shoreline, WA since 2010.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Welcome to Wireless Connect — your go-to destination for all your technology needs. Since 2010, we have been committed to providing top-notch services and products that keep you connected and your devices performing at their best.
story.p2: Every device we sell goes through a thorough 14-point testing process — we check screen quality, battery health, IMEI status, and all hardware functions before it goes out the door. We stand behind our products with a 30-day warranty on every eligible device.
story.p3: Whether you're a local customer looking to pick up in-store or a buyer anywhere in the United States, we ship nationwide so you can get a great device at a fair price. We also offer in-store phone and computer repair services for the greater Seattle area.

cta.title: Ready to Find Your Next Phone?
cta.description: Browse our current inventory of certified pre-owned devices.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: At Wireless Connect, our mission is to deliver innovative and reliable technology solutions that empower our customers. We aim to set the standard for quality, affordability, and honest service in the pre-owned device market.

whyUs.title: Why Choose Us
whyUs.expertiseBody: Our team brings years of hands-on experience and a deep understanding of the latest mobile technology. Every device is tested by a trained technician before it's listed for sale.
whyUs.qualityBody: We are committed to top-notch products that meet the highest standards of quality and performance. Clean IMEI, verified battery health, and a 30-day warranty on every eligible device.
whyUs.customerFocusBody: Your satisfaction is our priority. We're a locally owned business — you can walk in, talk to us, and we'll make it right. That's the local difference.

services.title: What We Offer
services.preOwnedBody: Thoroughly tested and certified pre-owned smartphones and laptops at honest prices.
services.repairBody: Mobile phone repair, iPhone screen replacement, computer repair, and Windows installation.
services.accessoriesBody: Chargers, cases, screen protectors, earpieces, SIM cards, and more.
